steps.title: Investigate a reported bug
steps.goal: A driver finished a parking session and questioned the number of billed blocks. blocks(minutes) returns the number of half-hour blocks started. Zero minutes costs zero blocks. Inputs are nonnegative whole minutes.
steps.opening: Read the incident and inspect the original behavior.
steps.task: Read README.md and meter.py. Record your prediction, repair the bug and write a regression in test_regression.py.
steps.expected: The public behavior checks pass and your test catches the original failure.
steps.hint: Compare a full block with a session that continues one more minute.
steps.reflection: What behavior does your test protect?
steps.evidencePrompt: What changed between the failing and passing runs?
